newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to start second round of talks with WTO.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to start second round of talks with WTO.

text.p: Croatia will begin a second round of negotiations with a group of member countries of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) on Thursday to pave the ground for its admission, state news agency HINA said on Wednesday.
Croatian officials will meet representatives of the Czech Republic, Slovakia, New Zealand, Australia and other countries in Geneva, HINA said.
The first round of talks was held on May 15 and 16. The negotiations were the first with the WTO after a year's pause, focusing on customs concessions for imported goods and services.

HINA said delegations of the European Union and the United States considered the time span between the first and the second round to be too short and refused to take part. They asked Croatia to postpone the bilateral talks till autumn.
Croatia's admission to the WTO is one of the conditions to gaining access to the Central European Free Trade Organisation (CEFTA). -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
